work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter LXXX congratulates Ferdinand II on the birth of Prince Alfonso; address, intitulation, greeting, body and dating clause survive. Its provenance note1 is LF17317. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF17225–17225; the source dating clause at LF17263–17266 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die quinta aprilis millesimo octin- gentesimo quadragesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo primo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
